category_edits.rationale: Reduce the causal context cap to max(1, ceil(0.75 × current_length)) for all four datasets, retaining recent interactions chronologically. Existing metadata propagates the reduced cap to the generated predictor. GRU topology, embeddings, readout, loss and optimizer remain unchanged.

change_summary: Reduce default context from 128 to 96 consistently across training, validation and prediction.
